Gluten-Free Apple Crisp
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Dessert
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • 1½ Cup(s) Bob's Red Mill 1 to 1 Baking flour
  • ¾ Cup(s) sugar
  • ¾ Cup(s) brown sugar
  • ½ Teaspoon(s) salt
  • 1 Cup(s) old-fashioned oats
  • 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces
  • 1 Recipe Apple Pie Filling
Instructions
  1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 9 by 14 baking dish.
  2. Prepare apples. Use corn starch or tapioca starch in place of flour. Spread apples in baking dish.
  3. To make the topping, combine the flour, sugars, salt, oatmeal, and cold butter in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Mix on low speed until the mixture is crumbly and the butter is the size of peas. Scatter evenly over the apples. You can cover with foil and freeze at this point if you want.
  4. Place dish on a rimmed baking sheet and bake in oven for 1 hour.
